item.title: CNN, MS NOW, Politico reporters denied access to White House following Trump ban
item.description: Three reporters were blocked from the White House grounds Saturday morning, a day after President Trump said CNN, Politico, and MS NOW would be banned for reporting "FICTION and LIES."

item.title: Tax relief or public danger? Florida voters weigh tax cuts against firefighter funding
item.description: Florida voters may end most residential property taxes - a step considered in other states. Local firefighters worry what it will do to their response times - and other officials are sounding alarms.
item.content:encoded: Florida voters may end most residential property taxes - a step considered in other states. Local firefighters worry what it will do to their response times - and other officials are sounding alarms.
item.dc:creator: Douglas Soule

item.title: Alaska's salmon-feasting bears face off in biggest Fat Bear Week ever
item.description: This year's single-elimination tournament will see 16 competitors face off, compared to 12 in past years. Officials report more cubs in Katmai National Park than they've seen in recent memory.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Trump says he is banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House
item.description: The president chalked the ban up to what he called unfavorable coverage, and he threatened that bans on other media companies could be coming.

item.title: Army medics being trained to treat wounded military dogs despite supply challenges

item.title: Poland's prime minister warns of Russian 'accidental' attacks on Ukraine's allies
